name: toggle
useFor: Use for one on or off option on a toolbar or map (show terrain, show parcel lines). Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label. For a setting in a form use Switch; for one choice among a few use Toggle Group.
constraints: A Forest-filled toggle outside a Toggle Group track
Movement or a size change when pressed
A toggle that runs an action (use Button)
source: Not in Figma; drawn from the keys on "UI · Buttons" (442:3)
title: Toggle
description: A key that stays pressed: 36px with the compact 6px cut and an 80% Forest label; a Fog fill steps in under the pointer and on it holds Mist with a Forest label. The outline variant is the framed key, on with a Forest line on Fog.
